title: Oscar and the Gravity
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Emrys Okafor, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
